import Std
namespace CapstoneV9Already
theorem symmetric_refl (x : Nat) : x = x := by
  induction x with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ x ih => rfl
end CapstoneV9Already

import Std
namespace CapstoneV9False
theorem successor_fixed (n : Nat) (seed : Nat) : n + 1 = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simpa using ih (seed + 1)
end CapstoneV9False

cases.family: false invariant with same induction failure

import Std
namespace CapstoneV9FalseRec

def pulse (flip : Bool → Bool) : Nat → Bool → Bool
  | 0, bit => bit
  | j + 1, bit => pulse flip j (flip bit)

theorem false_preservation (flip : Bool → Bool) (count : Nat) (bit : Bool) :
    pulse flip count bit = bit := by
  induction count with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ count ih =>
      simpa [pulse] using ih (flip bit)

end CapstoneV9FalseRec
